items.title: Fred Minor Interview, 1961-11-01
items.q: It's Leon Mumford's brother. Who? Remember Leon Mumford the piano? Yeah, yeah.

ctx.x: Uh, George White. No, you don't know him. Still around?
It's Leon Mumford's brother. Who? Remember Leon Mumford the piano? Yeah, yeah. His brother.
Oh yeah. Um, did you all have any regular jobs with the, say that Kazmer band we were talking about?
